description.text: Program Description Applied physical is training to master basic theory and method of physics, has the good mathematical foundation and basic experiment skills, master the electronic technology, computer technology, optical fiber communication technology, physical aspects of biomedical application of basic knowledge, basic experimental methods and techniques, in physics, post and telecommunication, aerospace, energy development, computer technology and application, optoelectronic technology, health care, automatic control technology and other related colleges and universities engaged in research, teaching, technology development and application, management of senior specialized talents. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Applied Physics at Shanghai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3083 USD/per year ￥ 22200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.(at least 1 A4 page)
